questions.prompt_md: Text: *The new canteen opens at eight.* True, False or Not mentioned: *The canteen serves vegetarian food.*
questions.explanation_md: El texto solo habla del horario; no dice nada del tipo de comida.

questions.prompt_md: Text: *Some customers complained about the delays, but most were satisfied with the service.* Which statement is correct?

choices.text: All customers complained about the delays.
The majority of customers were happy with the service.

questions.explanation_md: *Most were satisfied* = *the majority were happy*. (a) exagera; (c) no aparece; (d) contradice el texto.

questions.prompt_md: En el formato de referencia, ¿cuántas palabras como **máximo** debe tener cada respuesta abierta?
questions.explanation_md: El intervalo es de 40 a 60 palabras.

questions.prompt_md: Question: *Why did the company move to a new warehouse?* Which is the best opening sentence for your answer?

choices.text: This is a very interesting question about warehouses.
The company moved to a new warehouse because the old one was too small for its growing stock.
Warehouses are very important in logistics.
I think that companies should never move.
